title: Inference-Time Scaling in Agentic Hardware Verification Workflows: A Multi-Strategy Characterization Across Protocol Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2611.23905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inference-time scaling, allocating more compute during generation rather than pre-training, has demonstrated dramatic quality improvements for LLM reasoning tasks. Its behaviour in structured hardware verification code generation, where outputs must satisfy compiler correctness, protocol semantics, and functional coverage constraints simultaneously, is less understood. We present a systematic, simulator-grounded study of inference-time compute scaling for agentic UVM testbench synthesis targeting AMBA protocol bridges. Four inference strategies---zero-shot (\$0.04), raw-feedback iterative (\$0.81), structured inner-loop (\$0.95), and full dual-loop agentic synthesis (\$1.06)---are evaluated across four AMBA targets (Protocol Complexity Index 11.8--22.6) using the Protocol Verification Completeness (PVC) metric, functional coverage, and a six-class UVM error taxonomy (E1--E6). translated_title: 智能体硬件验证工作流中的推理时扩展：跨协议复杂度的多策略特征分析
translated_abstract: 推理时扩展，即在生成阶段而非预训练阶段分配更多计算资源，已在大语言模型推理任务中展现出显著的质量提升。然而，其在结构化硬件验证代码生成中的行为却鲜为人知——在这类任务中，输出必须同时满足编译器正确性、协议语义和功能覆盖率约束。我们针对AMBA协议桥接器的智能体式UVM测试平台合成，开展了一项系统性、基于仿真器的推理时计算扩展研究。我们在四个AMBA目标（协议复杂度指数11.8–22.6）上评估了四种推理策略——零样本（0.04美元）、原始反馈迭代（0.81美元）、结构化内循环（0.95美元）以及完整的双循环智能体合成（1.06美元），并采用协议验证完备性（PVC）指标、功能覆盖率以及六类UVM错误分类法（E1–E6）进行衡量。我们的核心发现是，结构化诊断反馈……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次对面向AMBA协议桥接的智能体式UVM测试平台合成中的推理时计算扩展进行了系统性的实证刻画，对比了四种不同成本的推理策略在不同协议复杂度下的验证质量，并指出结构化诊断反馈是提升硬件验证代码生成效果的关键。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic, simulator-grounded characterization of inference-time compute scaling in agentic UVM testbench synthesis for AMBA protocol bridges, comparing four strategies of varying cost across protocol complexity levels and showing that structured diagnostic feedback is key to hardware verification quality.
